units.source: Note menu

The note menu contains various actions and configurations for the current note. It can be found in the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note buttons__TRILIUM_PH_1__ area (to the right of the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Title__TRILIUM_PH_3__).

Every split has a note menu of its own, which acts on the note displayed in that split. Entries that don't apply to the current note are still listed but grayed out, while entries that only exist for some notes (described in __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note-specific entries__TRILIUM_PH_1__) appear only on those notes.
Navigating the note__TRILIUM_PH_0__

These entries are the row of icons at the top of the menu, each with a short title. Hovering one shows its full name and its keyboard shortcut. In Quick edit on a phone, where only __TRILIUM_PH_0__Find__TRILIUM_PH_1__ is left, it is listed as an ordinary entry instead.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Find__TRILIUM_PH_2__ opens the __TRILIUM_PH_3__Search in note__TRILIUM_PH_4__ bar, to find and replace text inside the current note. On the desktop application, the same bar opens with __TRILIUM_PH_5__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_6__+__TRILIUM_PH_7__F__TRILIUM_PH_8__.

It is available on __TRILIUM_PH_0__Text__TRILIUM_PH_1__, __TRILIUM_PH_2__Code__TRILIUM_PH_3__, __TRILIUM_PH_4__Mind Map__TRILIUM_PH_5__ and __TRILIUM_PH_6__Spreadsheets__TRILIUM_PH_7__ notes, __TRILIUM_PH_8__Collections__TRILIUM_PH_9__, PDF files, and any note displayed as __TRILIUM_PH_10__Note source__TRILIUM_PH_11__.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Attachments__TRILIUM_PH_2__ switches the note to the list of its __TRILIUM_PH_3__Attachments__TRILIUM_PH_4__, where they can be uploaded, opened, downloaded, renamed or deleted.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Note map__TRILIUM_PH_2__ opens the __TRILIUM_PH_3__Connections tab__TRILIUM_PH_4__ of the __TRILIUM_PH_5__Right Sidebar__TRILIUM_PH_6__, which shows the __TRILIUM_PH_7__Note Map (Link map, Tree map)__TRILIUM_PH_8__ centered on the current note.
Note properties__TRILIUM_PH_0__
The toggles in this section take effect immediately:
__TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Shared__TRILIUM_PH_2__ publishes the note via __TRILIUM_PH_3__Sharing__TRILIUM_PH_4__, by cloning it into the __TRILIUM_PH_5__Shared Notes__TRILIUM_PH_6__ tree.
Turning it off removes the clone from that tree. If the note exists only as a shared note, Trilium asks for confirmation, since unsharing it deletes it.
The toggle is unavailable on the root note, on the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Shared Notes__TRILIUM_PH_1__ note itself, and on system notes.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Protect the note__TRILIUM_PH_2__ encrypts the note, turning it into one of the __TRILIUM_PH_3__Protected Notes__TRILIUM_PH_4__. If no protected session is active, Trilium asks for the password first. Only the current note is affected, not its children.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Bookmark__TRILIUM_PH_2__ adds the note to the __TRILIUM_PH_3__Bookmarks__TRILIUM_PH_4__ that are displayed in the __TRILIUM_PH_5__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_6__, or removes it from them.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Template__TRILIUM_PH_2__ marks the note as one of the __TRILIUM_PH_3__Templates__TRILIUM_PH_4__ (by adding the __TRILIUM_PH_5__ label), which makes it available when creating a new note.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Full width__TRILIUM_PH_2__ lets the note use the whole width of the window instead of the limit set in __TRILIUM_PH_3__Content width__TRILIUM_PH_4__ by adding the __TRILIUM_PH_5__ label. It is not listed for note types that are always displayed at full width.
The two submenus in this section:

__TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Note type__TRILIUM_PH_2__ changes the type of the note to any of the __TRILIUM_PH_3__Note Types__TRILIUM_PH_4__; the current one is checked. If the note already has content, Trilium asks for confirmation first, since the content generally doesn't carry over. __TRILIUM_PH_5__Converting between note types__TRILIUM_PH_6__.
For a __TRILIUM_PH_0__Code__TRILIUM_PH_1__ note, the language is chosen in the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Status bar__TRILIUM_PH_3__ instead.
__TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Editable__TRILIUM_PH_2__ controls when the note opens as read-only (see __TRILIUM_PH_3__Read-Only Notes__TRILIUM_PH_4__):
__TRILIUM_PH_0__Auto__TRILIUM_PH_1__ (the default): the note is editable, unless it is long enough to be opened as read-only automatically.
__TRILIUM_PH_0__Read-only__TRILIUM_PH_1__: the note always opens as read-only, but can still be edited after pressing __TRILIUM_PH_2__Edit note__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
__TRILIUM_PH_0__Always editable__TRILIUM_PH_1__: the note is always editable, regardless of its length.
Importing, exporting and printing__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Note menu > Importing, exporting and printing

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Import files__TRILIUM_PH_2__ opens the import dialog, which imports files as children of the current note. See __TRILIUM_PH_3__Import & Export__TRILIUM_PH_4__. It is unavailable on __TRILIUM_PH_5__Saved Search__TRILIUM_PH_6__ notes.
units.context: Note menu > Importing, exporting and printing

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Export note__TRILIUM_PH_2__ opens the export dialog with __TRILIUM_PH_3__Only this note__TRILIUM_PH_4__ selected; select __TRILIUM_PH_5__This note & all descendants__TRILIUM_PH_6__ there to export the whole subtree.
units.context: Note menu > Importing, exporting and printing

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Print/export to PDF…__TRILIUM_PH_2__ prints the note or saves it as a PDF file. See __TRILIUM_PH_3__Printing & Exporting as PDF__TRILIUM_PH_4__, including which note types and collections can be printed.
units.context: Note menu > Importing, exporting and printing

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Export as image__TRILIUM_PH_2__, on __TRILIUM_PH_3__Mermaid Diagrams__TRILIUM_PH_4__ and __TRILIUM_PH_5__Mind Map__TRILIUM_PH_6__ notes, downloads the diagram as __TRILIUM_PH_7__PNG (raster)__TRILIUM_PH_8__ or __TRILIUM_PH_9__SVG (vector)__TRILIUM_PH_10__.

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Export to Excel (.xlsx)__TRILIUM_PH_2__ and __TRILIUM_PH_3__Export to CSV (.csv)__TRILIUM_PH_4__, on __TRILIUM_PH_5__Spreadsheets__TRILIUM_PH_6__, download the spreadsheet in those formats.

units.source: Revisions__TRILIUM_PH_0__
These entries manage the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Revisions__TRILIUM_PH_1__ of the note:

__TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Note revisions…__TRILIUM_PH_2__ opens the revisions dialog, where previous versions can be previewed, compared with the current one, downloaded or restored. The arrow beside it opens the entries that save a revision right away. On mobile, tapping it opens those entries, with __TRILIUM_PH_3__Note revisions…__TRILIUM_PH_4__ as the first one.
__TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Save revision__TRILIUM_PH_2__ saves a revision of the note right away, instead of waiting for the next automatic snapshot.
__TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Save named revision…__TRILIUM_PH_2__ also saves a revision right away, but first asks for a short description of the changes, which is shown in the revisions dialog.
Note-specific entries__TRILIUM_PH_0__
The following entries only appear on some notes:
__TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Edit note__TRILIUM_PH_2__ appears at the top of the menu when the note is currently read-only. It enables editing until the note is closed.
__TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Word wrap__TRILIUM_PH_2__ appears at the top of the menu on __TRILIUM_PH_3__Code__TRILIUM_PH_4__ notes, and sets whether long lines wrap in this note:

__TRILIUM_PH_0__Auto__TRILIUM_PH_1__ (the default) follows __TRILIUM_PH_2__Options__TRILIUM_PH_3__ → __TRILIUM_PH_4__Code Notes__TRILIUM_PH_5__ → __TRILIUM_PH_6__Wrap lines in code notes__TRILIUM_PH_7__.
__TRILIUM_PH_0__On__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and __TRILIUM_PH_2__Off__TRILIUM_PH_3__ override it for this note only, by setting the __TRILIUM_PH_4__ label.

__TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Convert into attachment__TRILIUM_PH_2__ appears on an image note that has no children and a single parent which is a __TRILIUM_PH_3__Text__TRILIUM_PH_4__ note. After a confirmation, it turns the image into an attachment of its parent note and opens it there. See __TRILIUM_PH_5__Attachments__TRILIUM_PH_6__.
__TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Re-render note__TRILIUM_PH_2__ appears on a __TRILIUM_PH_3__Render Note__TRILIUM_PH_4__, and runs its script again to refresh the output.
__TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Board properties__TRILIUM_PH_2__ appears on a __TRILIUM_PH_3__Kanban Board__TRILIUM_PH_4__, and configures its columns, card attributes and card templates.
__TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Calendar properties__TRILIUM_PH_2__ appears on a __TRILIUM_PH_3__Calendar__TRILIUM_PH_4__ that creates events, and configures its event templates.

__TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Geo map properties__TRILIUM_PH_2__ appears on a __TRILIUM_PH_3__Geo Map__TRILIUM_PH_4__, and configures its map settings and the image of an __TRILIUM_PH_5__image map__TRILIUM_PH_6__.
__TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Table properties__TRILIUM_PH_2__ appears on a __TRILIUM_PH_3__Table__TRILIUM_PH_4__, and configures which notes it shows.
Advanced__TRILIUM_PH_0__
The __TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Advanced__TRILIUM_PH_2__ submenu groups the actions that are needed less often:

__TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Open externally__TRILIUM_PH_2__ (desktop application only) saves the note to a temporary file and opens it in the application that the operating system associates with it. Trilium watches the file: each time it is saved, a notification in the window it was opened from offers to upload the modified version back into the note, keeping the current content as a revision. A file that the operating system would run as a program, such as a __TRILIUM_PH_3__, __TRILIUM_PH_4__, __TRILIUM_PH_5__ or __TRILIUM_PH_6__ file, is not opened; __TRILIUM_PH_7__Open with...__TRILIUM_PH_8__ can still open it in an application you pick. It is unavailable on __TRILIUM_PH_9__Collections__TRILIUM_PH_10__ and __TRILIUM_PH_11__Saved Search__TRILIUM_PH_12__ notes.

__TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Open with...__TRILIUM_PH_2__ (desktop application only) works like __TRILIUM_PH_3__Open externally__TRILIUM_PH_4__, but lets you pick the application to open the file with. See __TRILIUM_PH_5__Open with__TRILIUM_PH_6__ below.
__TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Note source__TRILIUM_PH_2__ shows the __TRILIUM_PH_3__Note source__TRILIUM_PH_4__, the content of the note exactly as it is stored.

__TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Convert to Markdown note__TRILIUM_PH_2__ (on text notes) and __TRILIUM_PH_3__Convert to text note__TRILIUM_PH_4__ (on Markdown notes) switch the note between rich text and Markdown. After a confirmation, Trilium saves a revision and converts the content; the revision allows going back if some formatting was lost. See __TRILIUM_PH_5__Converting between note types__TRILIUM_PH_6__.
__TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Compress images__TRILIUM_PH_2__ opens a dialog that reduces the size of the images in the note. It lists the images found and how much space they take, and offers to:
Resize the images larger than a chosen size.
Keep, or compress, JPEG images.
Keep, optimize, or convert to JPEG the PNG images.
__TRILIUM_PH_0__Process child notes as well__TRILIUM_PH_1__, to include the images of the notes beneath this one.
Compressing cannot be undone. Images can also be compressed automatically on upload, see __TRILIUM_PH_0__Images__TRILIUM_PH_1__.

__TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__View OCR text__TRILIUM_PH_2__ (on image and file notes) shows the text extracted from the note via __TRILIUM_PH_3__Text Extraction (OCR)__TRILIUM_PH_4__. If the note has not been processed yet, the dialog offers to __TRILIUM_PH_5__Process OCR__TRILIUM_PH_6__.

__TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Open note on server__TRILIUM_PH_2__ (desktop application only, listed when __TRILIUM_PH_3__Synchronization__TRILIUM_PH_4__ is configured) opens the same note on the sync server, in the web browser.
Open with__TRILIUM_PH_0__

__TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Open with...__TRILIUM_PH_2__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_3__Advanced__TRILIUM_PH_4__ submenu opens the note in an application you choose, instead of the one the operating system associates with its type. As with __TRILIUM_PH_5__Open externally__TRILIUM_PH_6__, Trilium saves the note to a temporary file, watches it, and offers to upload the modified version back into the note. The entry is available only in the desktop application; attachments offer the same action.
On Windows, the system's __TRILIUM_PH_0__Open with__TRILIUM_PH_1__ dialog lists the installed applications.
On Linux, the application chooser comes from the desktop portal (__TRILIUM_PH_0__), so it works in the Flatpak as well.

In the Flathub version, __TRILIUM_PH_0__Open externally__TRILIUM_PH_1__ also goes through the desktop portal, which can show the application chooser the first few times a file type is opened, as the system's policy decides; __TRILIUM_PH_2__Open with...__TRILIUM_PH_3__ always shows it.

On macOS, a file picker opens in the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Applications__TRILIUM_PH_1__ folder; the note opens in the application you select there, as with __TRILIUM_PH_2__Open With__TRILIUM_PH_3__ → __TRILIUM_PH_4__Other…__TRILIUM_PH_5__ in Finder.

If the application chooser cannot be shown (such as when no desktop portal is running on Linux), Trilium reports an error instead of opening the file. __TRILIUM_PH_0__Open externally__TRILIUM_PH_1__ still opens it in the default application.
Adding an application to the chooser on Linux__TRILIUM_PH_0__

units.source: Deleting the note__TRILIUM_PH_0__

__TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Delete note__TRILIUM_PH_2__ opens the deletion dialog for the current note and its subtree. The dialog lists the notes that will be deleted and the relations that will be broken, and offers to:

Also delete the other clones of the note, if it is cloned elsewhere. Otherwise, only the current placement is removed and the note stays in its other locations. See __TRILIUM_PH_0__Cloning Notes__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
__TRILIUM_PH_0__Erase permanently__TRILIUM_PH_1__ instead of the usual soft deletion. This cannot be undone.
Notes deleted without erasing can be brought back, see __TRILIUM_PH_0__Restoring Deleted Notes__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
Limitations__TRILIUM_PH_0__
The note menu is not available on launchers.

On the notes of __TRILIUM_PH_0__Options__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and of the in-app help, most entries are grayed out, since these notes cannot be imported into, deleted or have revisions. Of the two, only the in-app help can be exported, see __TRILIUM_PH_2__Import & Export__TRILIUM_PH_3__.

The __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note properties__TRILIUM_PH_1__ section is only listed when the note itself is displayed, not its __TRILIUM_PH_2__Attachments__TRILIUM_PH_3__ or its __TRILIUM_PH_4__Note source__TRILIUM_PH_5__.

In __TRILIUM_PH_0__Quick edit__TRILIUM_PH_1__, __TRILIUM_PH_2__Note map__TRILIUM_PH_3__, __TRILIUM_PH_4__Full width__TRILIUM_PH_5__ and __TRILIUM_PH_6__Convert into attachment__TRILIUM_PH_7__ are not listed.
Mobile support__TRILIUM_PH_0__

On the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Mobile Frontend__TRILIUM_PH_1__, the note menu opens as a sheet from the bottom of the screen. Besides the entries above, it contains the items that the desktop layout places elsewhere:

Two more icons in the row of icons at the very top of the sheet, which reads __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__New split__TRILIUM_PH_2__, __TRILIUM_PH_3__Note map__TRILIUM_PH_4__, __TRILIUM_PH_5__Find__TRILIUM_PH_6__ and __TRILIUM_PH_7__ __TRILIUM_PH_8__Child note__TRILIUM_PH_9__ from left to right: __TRILIUM_PH_10__New split__TRILIUM_PH_11__ opens a __TRILIUM_PH_12__Split View__TRILIUM_PH_13__ while there is none in the tab, and __TRILIUM_PH_14__Child note__TRILIUM_PH_15__ creates a note under the current one.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__Backlinks__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and __TRILIUM_PH_2__Note paths__TRILIUM_PH_3__, below the row of icons, which open the __TRILIUM_PH_4__Backlinks__TRILIUM_PH_5__ and the other locations of the note.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Attachments__TRILIUM_PH_2__ and __TRILIUM_PH_3__ __TRILIUM_PH_4__Attributes__TRILIUM_PH_5__, under them, which open the attachments and the attributes of the note, each with the number the note has. Links made by the content of the note are not counted as attributes. __TRILIUM_PH_6__Attributes__TRILIUM_PH_7__ is unavailable where the note cannot be edited. On mobile, __TRILIUM_PH_8__Attachments__TRILIUM_PH_9__ is listed here instead of in the row of icons.
The custom buttons of the note type (such as __TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__Download__TRILIUM_PH_2__ on a __TRILIUM_PH_3__File__TRILIUM_PH_4__).
__TRILIUM_PH_0__Close this pane__TRILIUM_PH_1__, on the second note of a __TRILIUM_PH_2__Split View__TRILIUM_PH_3__.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Note settings__TRILIUM_PH_2__, below __TRILIUM_PH_3__Protect the note__TRILIUM_PH_4__, which opens __TRILIUM_PH_5__Shared__TRILIUM_PH_6__ and __TRILIUM_PH_7__Bookmark__TRILIUM_PH_8__, then __TRILIUM_PH_9__Note type__TRILIUM_PH_10__, __TRILIUM_PH_11__Template__TRILIUM_PH_12__ and __TRILIUM_PH_13__Full width__TRILIUM_PH_14__, on a page of their own, together with the language of the note: the content language on __TRILIUM_PH_15__Text__TRILIUM_PH_16__ notes (see __TRILIUM_PH_17__Content language & Right-to-left support__TRILIUM_PH_18__), and the language of the code on __TRILIUM_PH_19__Code__TRILIUM_PH_20__ notes. The choices of __TRILIUM_PH_21__Editable__TRILIUM_PH_22__ are listed at the end of that page, under their own heading, instead of in a further submenu.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Note info__TRILIUM_PH_2__, below __TRILIUM_PH_3__Note settings__TRILIUM_PH_4__, which opens the dates, type, ID and size of the note on a page of its own, ending with __TRILIUM_PH_5__Show similar notes__TRILIUM_PH_6__ (see __TRILIUM_PH_7__Similar Notes__TRILIUM_PH_8__).
__TRILIUM_PH_0__Note map__TRILIUM_PH_1__ opens the map in a popup instead of the right sidebar.
